expectedLearning: Whether the current semantic and animation layers can converge without changing accepted choreography or introducing an equation-shaped universal model.
allowedWork: Behavior-preserving type extraction, dependency inversion, compatible facades and decoders, architecture gates, narrow projections, compiler and frame adapter migration, deterministic preservation fixtures, and bounded deletion with closure evidence.
Create stable focused and visual verification entry points and the minimum durable architecture evidence required by the approved slices.

Use brief Theseus context receipts, one independently reversible commit per slice, focused verification on every slice, broad gates at slices 6, 13, 22, and 28, and deterministic visual evidence at slices 6, 17, 18, and 28.
disallowedWork: Do not implement new curriculum or domains or redesign the editor, Workbench, reader, dashboard, or authoring surfaces.

Do not create a universal scene graph, CAS, theorem prover, second runtime or clock, arbitrary code execution, broad aesthetic changes, or delete compatibility without route, review, export, fixture, and reference closure.
Do not pause at slice 17 solely for human review; do stop on unexplained visual or semantic drift. The only planned human checkpoint is after slice 28.
goal: Converge KP's semantic-animation compiler into one enforceable dependency direction, typed presentation seam, canonical sampled-frame convention, narrow asset projections, and classified compatibility surface while preserving every accepted behavior in the gold cohort.
